017package org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
020
021/**
022 * JSON-RPC 2.0 success or error response envelope.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * Exactly one of {@code result} or {@code error} should be present for a valid response.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * This envelope is generic JSON-RPC 2.0 and carries no {@code _meta} property: MCP-specific per-result
029 * metadata belongs under {@code result._meta}, not beside the envelope. See the {@code 2026-07-28} v2 bean
030 * package ({@code org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728}) for the typed nested carrier.
031 */
032@Marshalled
033public class JsonRpcResponse {
034
035   private static final String JSONRPC_2_0 = "2.0";
036
037   private String jsonrpc;
038   private Object id;
039   private Object result;
040   private JsonRpcError error;
041
042   /**
043    * JSON-RPC protocol version.
044    *
045    * @return The version token, or {@code null} if not set.
046    */
047   public String getJsonrpc() {
048      return jsonrpc;
049   }
050
051   /**
052    * Sets the JSON-RPC protocol version.
053    *
054    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
055    * @return This object (for method chaining).
056    */
057   public JsonRpcResponse setJsonrpc(String value) {
058      jsonrpc = value;
059      return this;
060   }
061
062   /**
063    * Correlates to the {@link JsonRpcRequest#getId() request id}.
064    *
065    * @return The id, or {@code null} if not set.
066    */
067   public Object getId() {
068      return id;
069   }
070
071   /**
072    * Sets the response id.
073    *
074    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
075    * @return This object (for method chaining).
076    */
077   public JsonRpcResponse setId(Object value) {
078      id = value;
079      return this;
080   }
081
082   /**
083    * Result payload on success.
084    *
085    * @return The result, or {@code null} if not set.
086    */
087   public Object getResult() {
088      return result;
089   }
090
091   /**
092    * Sets the result payload.
093    *
094    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
095    * @return This object (for method chaining).
096    */
097   public JsonRpcResponse setResult(Object value) {
098      result = value;
099      return this;
100   }
101
102   /**
103    * Error payload on failure.
104    *
105    * @return The error, or {@code null} if not set.
106    */
107   public JsonRpcError getError() {
108      return error;
109   }
110
111   /**
112    * Sets the error payload.
113    *
114    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
115    * @return This object (for method chaining).
116    */
117   public JsonRpcResponse setError(JsonRpcError value) {
118      error = value;
119      return this;
120   }
121
122   /**
123    * Tests whether a JSON-RPC id identifies a notification (a request that must not be answered).
124    *
125    * <p>
126    * A JSON-RPC request with no {@code id} is a notification; the server performs the work and returns
127    * no response body.
128    *
129    * @param id The request id. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
130    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the id is <jk>null</jk>.
131    */
132   public static boolean notification(Object id) {
133      return id == null;
134   }
135
136   /**
137    * Creates a JSON-RPC 2.0 success response.
138    *
139    * @param id The request id to correlate against. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
140    * @param result The result payload. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
141    * @return A new response object. Never <jk>null</jk>.
142    */
143   public static JsonRpcResponse ok(Object id, Object result) {
144      return new JsonRpcResponse()
145         .setJsonrpc(JSONRPC_2_0)
146         .setId(id)
147         .setResult(result);
148   }
149
150   /**
151    * Creates a JSON-RPC 2.0 error response with no structured error data.
152    *
153    * @param id The request id to correlate against. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
154    * @param code The JSON-RPC error code.
155    * @param message The error message. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
156    * @return A new response object. Never <jk>null</jk>.
157    */
158   public static JsonRpcResponse errorResponse(Object id, int code, String message) {
159      return errorResponse(id, code, message, null);
160   }
161
162   /**
163    * Creates a JSON-RPC 2.0 error response.
164    *
165    * @param id The request id to correlate against. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
166    * @param code The JSON-RPC error code.
167    * @param message The error message. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
168    * @param data Optional structured error data. Can be <jk>null</jk> to leave the property unset.
169    * @return A new response object. Never <jk>null</jk>.
170    */
171   public static JsonRpcResponse errorResponse(Object id, int code, String message, Object data) {
172      return new JsonRpcResponse()
173         .setJsonrpc(JSONRPC_2_0)
174         .setId(id)
175         .setError(new JsonRpcError().setCode(code).setMessage(message).setData(data));
176   }
177}
